'''Clan Freykaa''' or '''House Freykaa''' was a famous [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] family on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Among its members was the late [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Chom Frey Kaa]]. "Freykaa" meant "beloved" in [[Twi'leki/Legends|Ryl]].
